method: Native Safari and Chrome apps operated through CUA. Toolbar edits, Command-R, browser downloads and native file pickers; observations from native accessibility trees. Backup metadata and SHA-256 independently checked from downloaded files. No DOM mutation or synthetic browser-event dispatch.
safariReload: Fresh main demo selected Make room for your ideas using native caret keys, changed Heading 2 to 4, wrapped it in a numbered list starting at 1, then Undo removed only the wrapper.
Command-R restored heading 4, selected heading text, enabled Undo and pending Redo, and All changes saved. Redo restored the numbered wrapper with rank 4 and marker 1; Undo removed it again.
chromeToSafari: Imported exact Chrome download breditor-session-backup (2).json through the native picker. Recovery showed heading 3, selected heading text, pending Redo and Autosave is off. Primary Safari document remained heading 4 with its own numbered-list Redo.

Recovered Redo restored bullet-wrapped heading 3. Undo removed the wrapper; another Undo restored heading 2 and disabled Undo. Two Redos restored heading 3 then its bullet wrapper. All cases retained the selected heading text and other sample items.

Command-R removed transient recovery and restored primary Safari heading 4, selected heading text, pending numbered-list Redo and All changes saved. Imported history did not overwrite Safari autosave.
safariToChrome: Downloaded primary Safari session; Safari Downloads showed breditor-session-backup-3.json, 5 KB. This is a different session from the imported Chrome backup: heading 4 with pending numbered wrapper, not heading 3 with pending bullet wrapper.

Imported exact Safari download into existing Chrome demo. Recovered heading 4, selected heading text, pending Redo and Autosave is off appeared separately from primary Chrome heading 3 and its own bullet-wrapper Redo.
Recovered Redo restored numbered heading 4 with marker 1. Undo removed wrapper; another Undo restored heading 2 and disabled Undo. Selected heading text remained visible throughout.
Command-R removed transient recovery and restored primary Chrome heading 3, selected heading text, enabled Undo/Redo and All changes saved. Safari history did not overwrite Chrome autosave.
limits: Bounded agent-operated native checks, not human attestation or broad browser certification. AX selected text alone does not prove native anchor/focus direction.
Current cross-browser cases cover two-entry heading/list histories, not every formatting property or session shape. Earlier richer five-step history evidence remains separate.
No input-source settings changed; no new physical IME or spoken VoiceOver evidence.
No historical intermittent WebKit queueUncertain fault reproduced or fixed here; size budgets and the complete release gate remain open.
No executable code, wire format or shipping artifacts changed. No push or publication.
